profile.visual_desc: Muscular blue-skinned humanoid with a black ponytail. Wears red wrist guards, a green waist sash, baggy navy trousers, and red leg wraps.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Shadow-obscured face featuring glowing yellow slit eyes. Stoic, intimidating expression with a dark muscular profile.
profile.weapon_desc: Unarmed strikes using both fists enhanced by spiritual energy.
profile.step1_ready: Front-isometric stance facing down-right. Body crouched low with fists held defensively near the torso.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward as light blue circular energy rings begin to manifest around the arms and shoulders.
profile.step3_impact: Rapid punching flurry toward the bottom-right. Large translucent blue energy rings and fist silhouettes expand along the strike path.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the final punch extension as energy rings fade. Returns to a rigid, wide-legged recovery pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The circular blue energy arcs must radiate outward following the direct forward punch trajectory toward the bottom-right target.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains character perspective and logical punch progression. VFX rings align with the forward trajectory and match reference motifs.
